Data:Slnev.dagmar.morgen.json.startdescription: Dagmar and Morgen discuss the relative virtues of dogs and cats. Morgen, who favours cats, points out that cats have been known to enter the Mansus without mortal or immortal intervention, and to bring 'gifts' back to the Wake. Dagmar uses this same point to argue for the superior virtues of dogs. [Lesson: Furs & Feathers]

Data:Slnev.dagmar.olympe.json.startdescription: Olympe is writing a novel where one of the characters is a criminal chemist specialising in acids and poisons; she's hoping Dagmar can help with her research. Dagmar is immediately wary, and keeps insisting that she only knows about 'lemon juice and things'; but once Olympe explains that the protagonist is based on Coquille, she relaxes enough to discuss the properties of Glassfinger Toxin. [Lesson: Solutions & Separations]

Data:Slnev.dagmar.serena.json.startdescription: Dagmar is quoting risqué jokes from Savage's 'A Seventh Voice' to Serena. Serena is pointing out oneirogenic correspondences in the rhyme schemes; Dagmar keeps chortling and quoting more jokes. [Lesson: Preliminal Meter]

Data:Slnev.dagmar.stanislav.json.startdescription: Dagmar describes matter-of-factly to Stanislav some of those routes through the Bounds which are available only to one who sheds her own blood. She even shows him the scars. [Lesson: Surgeries & Exsanguinations]

Data:Slnev.dagmar.visiting.denzil.json.startdescription: Dagmar describes how she's having the stables renovated so that Denzil will 'feel at home' when he comes to work for her. (She seems a little hazy about the living arrangements of blacksmiths.) Denzil explains again, very patiently, that he will not be coming to work for her. Dagmar begins talking about the anvils of Mitteleuropa. [Lesson: Door & Wall]

Data:Slnev.dagmar.visiting.killes.json.startdescription: Dagmar, chatting amiably to Mr Kille, disparagingly mentions the 1848 'Springtime of Nations' in a way that suggests she might have been present for it - which would make her something like ninety years old. Mr Kille expresses shock, then surprise, then begins to stammer. Dagmar waves the whole thing away: 'First, I was very young. Second, age is not a number. I'll tell you what's a number, though: nine. Nine's an utter number.'

Data:Slnev.dagmar.visiting.timothy.json.startdescription: Timothy has become aware, somehow, that Dagmar has a ruinous castle somewhere in Mitteleuropa, and that this quite naturally features a chapel. He has many questions about the construction and decoration of this chapel. Dagmar is initially delighted to talk about it, but her knowledge shows its weaknesses under the relentless cannonade of Reverend Timothy's questions. When he unfolds a list of further questions that he has prepared in advance, her courage fails her, she makes her excuses and heads outside for a smoke. Timothy, however, follows. [Lesson: Door & Wall]

Data:Slnev.dagmar.yvette.json.startdescription: Yvette and Dagmar have both dreamt of conversations with half-faced Xenodice, 'fair to strangers', Name of the Horned-Axe. Dagmar is convinced they both met the real Xenodice. Yvette is equally convinced that both of them were conversing with an ambassador from the collective unconscious, but she struggles to answer when Dagmar asks what the difference would be between that and an 'actual' Name. [Lesson: Rhyme & Remembrance]

Data:Slnev.dagmar.zachary.json.startdescription: Dagmar is trying to explain the more risqué jokes in Savage's 'A Seventh Voice' to Zachary. Zachary is courteously taking notes. [Lesson: Preliminal Meter]

Data:Slnev.douglas.agdistis.json.startdescription: Douglas and Agdistis speak of the Ecdysis Club, where Agdistis once worked and which Douglas had a hand in closing down. Douglas is unrepentant, but also regretful. [Lesson: Drums & Dances]

Data:Slnev.douglas.aladim.json.startdescription: Douglas and al-Adim are trying to work out whether the unusual nature of al-Adim's ascension to Longhood - under the Vagabond - actually means he hasn't actually broken any British laws. They decide that he probably has, but Douglas is very practical about the difficulties of arresting him, and offers to let him off with a caution if he doesn't ever ascend to immortality again. [Lesson: Edicts Inviolable]

Data:Slnev.douglas.arthur.json.startdescription: Douglas and Arthur have a businesslike chat about the Edge-dyad known as Dearday and Torgue, and the trouble they've caused over the years…. which is abruptly derailed when Douglas, who is after all a detective, pierces the veil of discretion surrounding Arthur's family history and realises that the concidence of surnames is not a coincidence, and that he's Arthur's great-nephew. Douglas' emotions are manifest only in his repetition of the phrase 'Well, I'll be blowed', and an unusually long handshake at the evening's end. [Lesson: Disciplines of the Scar]

Data:Slnev.douglas.arun.json.startdescription: Arun is concerned about the progress of a recent candidate for Lantern-longhood: he shares names and details with Douglas. 'Knife, noose, flame, word, hm? I don't like it; but I don't like this aspirant either.' [Lesson: Maggephene Mysteries]

Data:Slnev.douglas.azita.json.startdescription: Azita and Douglas speculate as to the current location and disposition of Teresa Galmier, who has twice been mortal, and twice grown Long… [Lesson: Purifications & Exaltations]

Data:Slnev.douglas.chaima.json.startdescription: Douglas and Chaima are enjoying a very practical conversation about what to do when someone bites you, what to do when something bites you, and what to do when someone bites something else. [Lesson: Stitching & Binding]

Data:Slnev.douglas.connie.json.startdescription: Douglas and Connie reminisce about old cases, and cheerfully speculate about the final fate of adepts they've locked up. [Lesson: Edicts Inviolable]

Data:Slnev.douglas.coquille.json.startdescription: Coquille smilingly asks Douglas to remind her if there is an arrest warrant out for her just now. 'Not just now,' he replies, 'but I'm sure we can sort something out.' Coquille spends much of the rest of the meal quoting from Zahra's 'Time of Division', and asking which bits would get her arrested if she recited them at a cocktail party. [Lesson: Surgeries & Exsanguinations]

Data:Slnev.douglas.corso.json.startdescription: Douglas and Corso discuss the nuances of the differences in the Received and Sanctioned versions of the Book of Suns… once Corso's got over his surprise at Douglas' interests. ('No-one ever bleeding believes I got a bleeding scholarship,' Douglas grumbles.) [Lesson: Sacra Solis Invicti]

Data:Slnev.douglas.dagmar.json.startdescription: With the ghoulish camaraderie of two pensioners in a retirement home, Douglas and Dagmar discuss the details of their medical issues, and their subsequent surgeries. [Lesson: Surgeries & Exsanguinations]

Data:Slnev.douglas.ehsan.json.startdescription: Douglas asks Ehsan if it's true that he used to dig in the ground like a mole; whether he was born or made; whether he's ever 'et anyone'. Ehsan answers the questions with courtesy: not exactly; not born; and no. [Lesson: Purifications & Exaltations]

Data:Slnev.douglas.fraser.json.startdescription: Fraser would like to know what Douglas proposes to 'do about Raw Prophets.' Douglas doesn't plan to do anything about Raw Prophets. Fraser would like to know, then, what the Bureau intends to do about Raw Prophets. Douglas expresses his confusion. Fraser expresses his irritation. Douglas expresses his inability to do anything about Raw Prophets. Both men agree that Raw Prophets aren't the kind of thing you can really do anything about. [Lesson: Stone Stories]

Data:Slnev.douglas.hokobald.json.startdescription: Douglas and Hokobald struggle to find common ground, until a chance remark brings up the Endeavour Club's enthusiasm for acts of pyromancy and, occasionally, outright arson. Both agree that the Endeavour Club is a gang of firestarting snobs that wants locking up. [Lesson: Pyroglyphics]

Data:Slnev.douglas.morgen.json.startdescription: Once again, Morgen teases Douglas with troublesome hypotheticals: in the case of an attack by various of her un-sisters, say the Lady of Wires or the Mother of Monsters, what techniques might Douglas use to drive them off? But he answers her steadily, and once he even manages to meet her horizon-blue eyes. [Lesson: Quenchings & Quellings]

Data:Slnev.douglas.olympe.json.startdescription: Douglas warns Olympe darkly of the dangers of knitting before sleep, and the paths it can open in the Wood. ('Yes, I knit. Gentlemen can knit.')  [Lesson: Weaving & Knotworking]

Data:Slnev.douglas.serena.json.startdescription: Douglas and Serena discuss a shared, concealed, but evidently profound passion for knitting. Douglas: 'If you tell anyone outside this room, I'll have you locked up.' Serena: 'If you tell anyone outside this room, I'll give King Crucible your address.' [Lesson: Weaving & Knotworking]

Data:Slnev.douglas.stanislav.json.startdescription: Stanislav asks Douglas about the death - reputedly murder - of the Abbess Nonna, almost six hundred years ago. Douglas acknowledges it's technically within the Bureau's jurisdiction; and that the Bureau doesn't recognise any statute of limitations short of eternity; and adds that he has a great deal on his plate; but promises to look into it, and asks Stanislav some incisive questions about rare poisonous herbs. [Lesson: Herbs & Infusions]

Data:Slnev.douglas.visiting.denzil.json.startdescription: Denzil and Douglas are complaining amicably about the recent decline in the quality of their preferred pipe tobacco. [Lesson: Door & Wall]

Data:Slnev.douglas.visiting.killes.json.startdescription: Douglas asks Mr Kille whether any of the occupants of his coffins have ever caused 'difficulties' before, after or during burial. Mr Kille, clearly sceptical, answers that they never have. Douglas nevertheless suggests refinements which might prevent any such misbehaviour, if it were ever to occur. [Lesson: Glassblowing & Vesselcrafting]

Data:Slnev.douglas.visiting.timothy.json.startdescription: Douglas has difficult questions for Timothy about a fugitive who has been seen along the coast. Timothy is initially evasive but crumbles almost instantly and admits that he took pity on the man in a spirit of charity, and instructed his housekeeper Terrence to take meals to the coal-cellar where the man was hiding for almost a week...

Data:Slnev.douglas.yvette.json.startdescription: Yvette and Douglas discuss those among the Dead that they have both met. Yvette speaks of mouthless, pleading shadows, moving as if underwater on the threshold before sleep. Douglas speaks of gash-mouthed shatter things that 'tried to pull me 'ead off.' [Lesson: Rhyme & Remembrance]

Data:Slnev.douglas.zachary.json.startdescription: Douglas tries to reminisce with Zachary about their shared work at the Suppression Bureau - the time they had to suppress a Percussigant troupe which was roaming the Forest of Dean. But Zachary only stares and shakes his head - 'I don't remember' - 'I don't remember' - 'I remember that it was cold' - 'I don't remember'. [Lesson: Quenchings & Quellings]

Data:Slnev.ehsan.agdistis.json.startdescription: Ehsan and Agdistis discuss duendrazones, the Heart-long who are eternally active, and possess mortals so they can sometimes know peace. 'I had hoped to be something like that, once,' Agdistis said, 'but I learnt from my friend Sulochana what it means to be a Long, and I set my face against it.' [Lesson: Purifications & Exaltations]

Data:Slnev.ehsan.aladim.json.startdescription: Ehsan and al-Adim are talking about goats. They both seem remarkably well-informed and exceptionally enthusiastic about goats. Neither of them will quite admit to ever having been a goatherd. [Lesson: Furs & Feathers]

Data:Slnev.ehsan.arthur.json.startdescription: Arthur speaks of the lightsmithing arts practised at the Labyrinth of Lions; Ehsan offers to show Arthur the stained glass windows in the chapel of Hush House after the meal ('with your permission, Librarian'?). [Lesson: Glaziery & Lightsmithing]

Data:Slnev.ehsan.arun.json.startdescription: Ehsan gives Arun practical advice on the preservation and protection of those parts of Arun that are no longer protected and preserved by skin. [Lesson: Stitching & Binding]

Data:Slnev.ehsan.azita.json.startdescription: Ehsan and Azita are discussing Ehsan's time as a skaptodon, a warrior-creation of the Lionsmith. There was more than one reason that Ehsan allowed himself to be debased into human shape. His enthusiasm for seafood was one; but he was never comfortable as a warrior. (Azita shakes her head and smiles.) [Lesson: Furs & Feathers]

Data:Slnev.ehsan.chaima.json.startdescription: Ehsan and Chaima discuss Nina Lagasse's account of the Roost of the Aviform Hours, and speculate about whether she really visited it. Ehsan is inclined to believe she did. 'I met her once, in Paris, not long before the Sun-in-Rags called her home. She was remarkable...' [Lesson: Sky Stories]

Data:Slnev.ehsan.connie.json.startdescription: Ehsan wants to know if Connie ever gets tired of enforcing laws. 'I might ask you,' she responds, 'if you ever get tired of healing bodies.' [Lesson: Edicts Inviolable]

Data:Slnev.ehsan.coquille.json.startdescription: Ehsan and Coquille speak of Tryphon, the Grail-long. Ehsan says: 'She was adored; and so she was happy.' An expression passes like cloud-shadow over Coquille's face, and for a moment she looks older. 'No,' she says, 'she was adored, and so she was not happy.' [Lesson: Applebright Euphonies]
